metadata.title: Indian E-Commerce Customer Retention Feature Manifest
metadata.leakage_safeguard: All behavioral and transaction features are calculated strictly using historical orders where order_date <= 2025-12-31. Future orders are strictly excluded.

target_definition.name: churn

values.0: Retained (Customer completed at least 1 order between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31)
values.1: Churned (Customer placed zero orders between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31)

target_definition.source: Existing validated ground truth from data/raw/customers.csv

customer_name.description: Customer full name (Excluded from predictive models to prevent demographic overfitting)

city.formula: customers.city with missing values encoded as 'Unknown'

state.formula: customers.state with missing values encoded as 'Unknown'

customer_tenure_days.description: Account age in days as of snapshot date (2025-12-31)

has_historical_orders.description: Flag indicating whether customer has placed at least 1 order prior to snapshot date

recency_days.description: Days elapsed since the customer's last recorded order attempt across all statuses as of 2025-12-31 (NaN for zero-order accounts)

recency_delivered_days.description: Days elapsed since the customer's last successfully delivered order as of 2025-12-31 (NaN if no delivered orders)

has_delivered_order.description: Flag indicating whether customer has at least 1 delivered order prior to snapshot date

hist_order_count.description: Total historical recorded orders placed by customer

hist_returned_order_count.description: Total historical orders returned by customer

hist_cancelled_order_count.description: Total historical orders cancelled before delivery

hist_total_order_value_inr.description: Cumulative gross value of all booked orders placed by customer (INR)
hist_total_order_value_inr.formula: Sum of order_amount_inr across all historical orders

hist_delivered_order_value_inr.description: Cumulative gross sales value of successfully delivered orders (INR)

hist_total_recorded_discount_inr.description: Cumulative promotional discount amount recorded for customer (INR, skipna=True)
hist_total_recorded_discount_inr.formula: Sum of recorded discount_amount_inr across historical orders

hist_average_order_value_inr.description: Average booked order value (AOV) per customer (INR). Exactly 0.0 for zero-order accounts by deliberate convention.

orders_last_30_days.description: Total orders booked within the last 30 days of the snapshot period (2025-12-02 to 2025-12-31)

orders_last_90_days.description: Total orders booked within the last 90 days of the snapshot period (2025-10-03 to 2025-12-31)

orders_last_180_days.description: Total orders booked within the last 180 days of the snapshot period (2025-07-05 to 2025-12-31)

delivered_orders_last_30_days.description: Delivered orders completed in last 30 days before snapshot date
delivered_orders_last_30_days.formula: Count of delivered orders where order_date >= 2025-12-02

delivered_orders_last_90_days.description: Delivered orders completed in last 90 days before snapshot date
delivered_orders_last_90_days.formula: Count of delivered orders where order_date >= 2025-10-03

delivered_orders_last_180_days.description: Delivered orders completed in last 180 days before snapshot date
delivered_orders_last_180_days.formula: Count of delivered orders where order_date >= 2025-07-05

hist_return_rate.description: Proportion of customer orders that were returned

hist_cancellation_rate.description: Proportion of customer orders that were cancelled

hist_average_delivery_delay_days.description: Average delivery delay days experienced across recorded historical orders (NaN if no records)

hist_delivery_delay_missing_count.description: Count of historical orders where delivery delay was unrecorded
hist_delivery_delay_missing_count.formula: Count of orders where delivery_delay_days is null

hist_delivery_delay_missing_rate.description: Proportion of customer orders with missing delivery delay records

hist_average_discount_amount_inr.description: Average promotional discount received on recorded discounted orders (INR)

hist_discounted_order_count.description: Count of historical orders with recorded discount > 0

hist_discount_missing_count.description: Count of historical orders where discount information was missing
hist_discount_missing_count.formula: Count of orders where discount_amount_inr is null

hist_discount_missing_rate.description: Proportion of orders with missing discount record

hist_payment_missing_count.description: Count of historical orders where payment method was unrecorded (null)
hist_payment_missing_count.formula: Count of historical orders where payment_method is null

hist_payment_missing_rate.description: Proportion of customer orders with unrecorded payment method

hist_cod_order_count.description: Number of orders paid using Cash on Delivery (COD)

hist_cod_usage_rate.description: Proportion of customer orders paid using Cash on Delivery (COD)

hist_upi_order_count.description: Number of orders paid using Unified Payments Interface (UPI)

hist_upi_usage_rate.description: Proportion of customer orders paid using Unified Payments Interface (UPI)

churn.description: Ground truth 90-day churn label (0 = Retained, 1 = Churned)
churn.formula: 1 if customer placed zero orders between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31 else 0
